title: capsicum indicum var. pyramidale
intro: Capsicum indicum var. pyramidale, commonly known as Korean red pepper or Cheongyang red pepper, is a variety of chili pepper that belongs to the Capsicum genus. This plant is known for its numerous health benefits, which include reducing inflammation, improving circulation, and boosting the immune system, due to its high content of antioxidants and capsaicin. The therapeutic actions of Capsicum indicum var. pyramidale include analgesic, anti-inflammatory, and antibacterial properties, which make it useful in traditional medicine for treating pain, fever, and infections. The bioactive constituents of this plant include capsaicin, flavonoids, and phenolic acids, which contribute to its medicinal properties and potential health benefits.
